observables.name: V_m
observables.description: Membrane voltage per neuron — fast state variable in DynamicState.v
observables.independence_note: Independent state — part of X_t slice of C_t

observables.name: spikes
observables.units: bool (threshold V>=30 mV) → Hz when binned
observables.description: Spike events — threshold crossings V>=30 mV, stored as prev_spikes in DynamicState + emitted as event
observables.independence_note: Ambiguous ownership: STATE as prev_spikes (carry) + OUTPUT as event stream; independent yes* with ownership STATE/OUTPUT where ambiguous per task

observables.name: u
observables.description: Recovery variable u — second Izhikevich state, DynamicState.u

observables.name: syn_state
observables.description: Synaptic state per edge — carries filtered spike history for edge i

observables.name: H
observables.description: Adaptive history state H — scalar per neuron implemented, conceptual 5-coord per jomission/dynamics/h_state.py:28
observables.provenance: jomission/dynamics/h_state.py:28 H_COORDINATES 5 taus + jaxfne/_pipeline.py DynamicState.H + manifests/agsdr_local_freeze.json:97
observables.independence_note: Independent adaptive state — slow, history; gated mismatch until M-06 per gen2_gates.py:110

observables.name: Theta
observables.description: Plastic parameters Theta — slow variables with tau_theta 1000s, lr1e-4, channels edge_weight+intrinsic_drive
observables.independence_note: Independent plastic state — carried in ContinuationState.w / HDP, not derived from X

observables.name: delay_state
observables.description: Delay/history ring buffer B_t — ring of past spikes for delayed edges

observables.name: V_centered (V_i - bar V) — relative_V
observables.description: Relative voltage V_i - mean(V) — mean subtraction per field gauge, not independent state; DERIVED_FROM(V_m) (V1 graph C_t→X_t→q_t→φ_t→y_t, jomission/visualization/model_summary.py:observable_basis())
observables.independence_note: DERIVED_FROM(V_m) — dependent on V_m; must label DERIVED_FROM(V_m) per V4 adversary N1/Misleading normalization; semantic_class DERIVED

observables.name: q (source / current proxy)
observables.description: Source/current proxy q_t = source_scale * (I_tonic+I_private+I_noise+I_syn + gain*spikes) — per-neuron continuous source
observables.provenance: jaxfne/emitters.py:55 source_scale + jaxfne/presets.py DEFAULT_SPIKE_IMPULSE_GAIN + builder.py:49 Poisson2kHz amp2.0 + :159 tonic3.0
observables.independence_note: q source depends on definition — if defined as instantaneous current from X+A+Static, then DERIVED_FROM(X,A); if defined as filtered source with own dynamics, ownership ambiguous. Here: OUTPUT derived from X_t,A_t,Static per advisor (not independent state)

observables.name: phi (field_proxy / LFP-like proxy_readout)
observables.description: Field proxy phi_t = project_laminar_sources(q_t) — laminar field_proxy (mean_zero_neumann gauge, proxy_no_field_solve jomission/network/builder.py:409, not PDE solve, never physical LFP, proxy_readout)
observables.provenance: jaxfne/_config.py field(source_mode='proxy_no_field_solve') builder.py:409 + jaxfne/fields/proxy.py:148 project_laminar_sources + jaxfne/io.py manifest field_solver_status 'linear_solver' claim_level 'proxy_readout'
observables.independence_note: DERIVED_FROM(q) — deterministic projection of source; FIELD_PROXY proxy_readout not physical LFP per V4 adversary U3; semantic_class FIELD_PROXY, proxy_status True

observables.name: CSD (CSD-like second derivative) — CSD_proxy
observables.description: CSD-like = second spatial derivative of phi_proxy along depth — post-hoc DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy) (field_proxy / LFP-like proxy_readout, never physical CSD)
observables.provenance: jaxfne/fields.py probe_laminar_modes + builder.py:409 proxy_no_field_solve + builder.py:410 probe + jaxfne/io.py manifest csd_sign_convention + jaxfne/fields/proxy.py:192 + vis_V4_adversary.md N2
observables.independence_note: DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy) — not independent measurement; labeling as independent CSD double-counts phi evidence per V4; semantic_class DERIVED, proxy_status True

observables.name: y (probe readout)
observables.description: Probe readout y_t = Probe(n_contacts=16) @ phi_t — linear readout per laminar contact
observables.independence_note: DERIVED_FROM(phi) — linear transform of field; readout, not state

observables.name: W (EdgeList weights)
observables.units: native current * gain (includes lognormal CV1.5 + motif gains) — display log: sign·log1p(|W|/1e-6) heavy tail, builder.py:142 sigma1.085
observables.description: Edge weights — per-edge static after spatial locality + motif scaling + lognormal (heavy tail CV1.5). Visualization: log abs weight with sign preserved (_safe_log_abs_weight, zero/sign-safe via log1p(|W|/eps)), linear for CV/rho/Fano per A2. Network_viz weight heatmaps log10.
observables.provenance: jomission/network/builder.py:62 MOTIF_GAIN 16 + :395 spatial_sigma0.08 + :142 CV1.5 sigma1.085 mu-0.589 (heavy tail) + jaxfne/emitters.py EdgeList + V0-P1 log scaling
observables.independence_note: Static latched per model instance (hash-visible), not per-step dynamic; counts toward N_static per-edge; vis scaling log for weight, linear for CV/rho/Fano (A2)

observables.name: positions
observables.description: Neuron positions — 3D per neuron for spatial pruning, depth bands L1 0-0.10 etc.

C_t.label: Full continuation state
C_t.storage: ContinuationState pytree — every simulation segment carry

X_t.label: Fast neural state
X_t.note: X is strictly fast (dt0.1ms); no H/Theta

A_t.label: Adaptive / history state
variables: H scalar per neuron (1×400) conceptual 5 dims taus 0.1/1/10/100/1000s
Theta vector theta_dim=2 population restoring (tau_theta 1000s, lr1e-4, bounds [-0.1,0.1])
A_t.provenance: jomission/dynamics/h_state.py:28 H_COORDINATES 5 taus + jomission/dynamics/hdp.py:14 HDPConfig + jaxfne/_pipeline.py ContinuationState.delay_state
A_t.note: A is slow/history; H is H_fast…H_context conceptual vs implemented scalar per freeze

q_t.label: Source / current
variables: q_t = source_scale * (I_tonic+I_private+I_noise+I_syn + spike_gain*spikes) — canonical relative source
q_t.provenance: jaxfne/emitters.py:55 IZHIKEVICH_CELL_TYPE_DEFAULTS + jaxfne/presets.py DEFAULT_SPIKE_IMPULSE_GAIN + jomission/network/builder.py:49 Poisson 2kHz amp2.0 + :159 tonic 3.0
q_t.note: q is not spike count; it is continuous source proxy per neuron

phi_t.label: Field (field_proxy / LFP-like proxy_readout, never physical LFP)
variables: phi_t = project_laminar_sources(q_t) — laminar field_proxy (mean_zero_neumann gauge, proxy_no_field_solve builder.py:409, not PDE solve)
phi_t.provenance: jaxfne/fields + jaxfne/_config.py field(source_mode='proxy_no_field_solve') builder.py:409 + jaxfne/io.py manifest field_solver_status 'linear_solver' claim_level 'proxy_readout'
phi_t.note: Field is field_proxy (LFP-like proxy_readout); not calibrated in physical units (truth gate clamped); FIELD_PROXY, proxy_status True

y_t.label: Probe / CSD (probe READOUT, CSD DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy))
variables: y_t = Probe(n_contacts=16) @ phi_t — linear readout per contact (READOUT, proxy_readout)
CSD = second spatial derivative of phi_proxy (DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy), proxy_readout)
y_t.provenance: jaxfne/_config.py probe(n_contacts=16) + jaxfne/fields.py probe_laminar_modes + jomission/network/builder.py:410 cfg.probe(n_contacts=16)
y_t.note: Probe is READOUT; CSD is DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy) post-hoc, not independent state

edges.transform: H modulates I, w scales syn_state

derived_transforms.name: relative_V (V_i - bar V)
derived_transforms.note: Not independent state; mean subtraction per field gauge; DERIVED_FROM(V_m) (V1 graph C_t→X_t→q_t→φ_t→y_t)

derived_transforms.name: CSD
derived_transforms.note: Second spatial derivative of phi_proxy along depth; not independent state; DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy) via linear_solver
derived_transforms.provenance: jaxfne/fields.py + jaxfne/io.py manifest csd_sign_convention + builder.py:409 proxy_no_field_solve

derived_transforms.name: field_proxy (LFP-like proxy_readout)
derived_transforms.note: Weighted sum of sources per laminar mode via project_laminar_sources; proxy_no_field_solve not physical LFP/EEG

derived_transforms.name: EI_proxy (Efrac_proxy W·r)
derived_transforms.note: Efrac_proxy W·r is PROXY_ESTIMATE not realized; realized requires edge_current_trace blocked by jaxfne/_model_simulate.py:280 when delay_steps [20,80,120]+HDP

derived_transforms.name: Population rate
derived_transforms.note: Binned spike counts; not state; DERIVED_FROM(spikes) X

derived_transforms.name: ISI CV / Fano
derived_transforms.note: Statistics of spike train; not state; DERIVED_FROM(spikes)

dependency_classification.X: V_m, spikes, syn_state — fast, per dt0.1, advisor class X → STATE
dependency_classification.A: H, Theta, delay/history — slow/history, advisor class A → ADAPTIVE_STATE
dependency_classification.q: source/current — per neuron continuous, class q → SOURCE
dependency_classification.phi: field_proxy (LFP-like proxy_readout) — laminar proxy, class phi → FIELD_PROXY
dependency_classification.y: probe (READOUT) / CSD (DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy)) — measurement, class y → READOUT / DERIVED

invariant: C_t carries truth; X_t and A_t are slices; q,phi,y are deterministic transforms; derived quantities (relative_V DERIVED_FROM(V_m), CSD DERIVED_FROM(field_proxy)) are not added to state count; V1 graph C_t→X_t→q_t→φ_t→y_t
